Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo recap + mutual action plan

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we stay aligned:

Call recap:
- Primary use-case: low-latency LLM-based summarization of customer support tickets for 2M monthly messages.
- Current pain: unpredictable inference costs and latency spikes during daily peaks.
- Success criteria: 50% cost reduction per 1k tokens and p95 latency <400ms for prioritised routes.

Suggested next steps (proposed timeline):
1) Share M&A (mutual action plan) with milestones and owners — I attached a draft. (Action: Marissa)
2) Tech deep-dive with your infra team to validate integration and estimated throughput (2-3 people, 60m) — are Tue/Thu next week options? (Action: Aditya)
3) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence — I attached a one-page SOC2 summary to speed review. (Action: Marissa)
4) Procurement & pricing conversation — we can prepare a term sheet once the M&A is agreed.

Attachments: Aurora_Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

If that timeline looks right, I’ll lock in the deep-dive and loop in our solutions engineer. If priorities have shifted on your side, let me know and we can adjust.

Thanks — talk soon,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the summary and attachments. A few quick notes:

- The M&A looks good at a high level. I’ll distribute to our infra and security teams and get back with questions.
- For the tech deep-dive, Tue 16th at 11am PT should work; I’ll confirm with my infra lead.
- Procurement timeline: likely Q2 budget window, but we need pricing and an estimated monthly spend to model. Can you share ballpark pricing for the Dedicated offering (committed capacity) and any reference usage profiles?
- Security: our security lead will want more SOC2 detail — the one-pager helps but they’ll probably ask for the auditor report or an SSP excerpt.

I’ll follow up once I hear from the rest of the team.

—Alex
